context.body: Precise dates, rising waters, the floating ship, and comprehensive death are narrated together.

observations.body: The fountains and windows open; Noah, his household, and living creatures enter, and the LORD shuts him in.
observations.label: The LORD shuts Noah in as the flood rises: action

observations.body: The waters rise until all dry-land life outside dies; only Noah and those with him remain.
observations.label: The LORD shuts Noah in as the flood rises: response

observations.body: the LORD shut him in · waters increased · all flesh died · only Noah was left

payload.posture: Read Genesis 7:11–24 as warning and the ship evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Noah is preserved inside a scene whose dominant outcome is the destruction of other life.
